notes: The exact palette indices Vic3's rivers.png uses, read from the shipped file. Only these entries carry meaning; every other index is padded to black by the writer. Semantics were confirmed empirically: index 254 (grey) covers 67.5% of the canvas and is 99.5% province-sea, index 255 (white) is 99.1% province-land, and the drawn rivers (0.38% of pixels, 97.5% on land) use a green source (0), a red merge marker (1), a yellow split marker (2) and a blue width ramp that widens downstream (3 -> 4 -> 6 -> 8). We reproduce vanilla's palette verbatim so a re-save cannot remap the semantic indices.
